levels.description:
Immediately nullifies the <$ba.invisible>Invisibility</> of enemies around for <@ba.vup>{anti_invisible_duration}</>s and switches to a <Substitute>
Gains <@ba.vup>+{attack_speed}</> ASPD and <$ba.invisible>Invisibility</> over the skill duration
